Description: 37 North is the sole-owner corporation representing video designer Ian Winters to provide media consulting and design services for site specific media to arts and performances organizations primarily in San Francisco, NY and London. Specific services conducted at home are all computer based: drafting written correspondence, phone / skype calls, preparation of drawings, programming,and other administrative tasks with no client visits. All fabrication and installation of projects are at offsite venues such as Cal Performances / Zellerbach Hall at UC Berkeley, Yerba Buena Center for the Arts in San Francisco, Lincoln Center in NYC, the Barbican, London; National Taiwan Theater, Taichung.
